  CASE PLANNER:  Roger Kiesel , Senior Planner
  PROJECT DESCRIPTION
  A vesting tentative subdivision map has been filed showing a proposed
  development of land at 520 North Central Avenue and 521 North Orange Street
  for the purpose of creating a new 98-unit residential condominium project.

  ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
  The project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 32 "In-fill Development
  Projects" exemption pursuant to Section 15331 of the State CEQA Guidelines

  3
 Pl<!nning Cotmnission Minutes
February 5, 2020

  STAFF
  Staff Member Roger Kiesel , Senior Planner, presented the staff report and
  highlighted the main items of the staff report. He answered questions from the
  Planning Commissioners.

  Mr. Kiesel stated that the applicant is proposing to subdivide an approved
  development (variance and design review approved by City Council) into 98 multi-
  family residential units and one commercial unit for condominium purposes. The
  development includes converting an existing eight-story office building on the east
  side of Central Avenue into 53 multi-family residential units, with commercial uses at
  the ground level and constructing 45 multi-family residential units (adding five
  stories) above an existing four-level parking structure on the west side of Orange
  Street.

  The existing building located at 520 North Central Avenue will contain commercial
  tenants on the ground level. Levels 2 through 7 of this building will contain eight
  multi-family units each, while the eighth level will contain six multi-family units. The
  residential units in this building will range from 1,033 square feet to 2,063 square
  feet in area.

  Staff member Roger Kiesel stated that Community Development Department staff
  recommends that the Planning Commission approve Vesting Tentative Tract Map
  No. 82713 located at 520 North Central Avenue & 521 North Orange Street, with
  findings and conditions as stated in the staff report dated February 5, 2020.

  APPLICANT
  Mr. Robert Montano, represented the applicant and the owner of the project. He
  presented the project details. He stated that
  - At present the building is vacant.
  - Building permits have been obtained.
  - Construction will take approximately two years.

  WRITTEN COMMUNICATION
  In Support:  None.
  Interested Persons: None
  In Opposition:  None.

  SPEAKING AT THE HEARING
  In Support:  No one.
  In Opposition :  No one.
  Interested Persons: No one.

  DISCUSSION BY COMMISS IONERS

  Planning Commissioners discussed:
  The parking and mitigation
  Easement on the property

  4
  Pl(lnning Commission Minutes
 February 5, 2020

  Upon questioning by the Planning Commissioners, staff member Roger Kiesel stated
  that:
  Even though this proposed project is in the ''DSP" zone, and since this is a sub-
  division , Planning Commission has to review and make a decision.
  - City Council has approved this proposed project in October 2018 (two variances
  and Design Review
  Parking Exception has been granted by the Director of Community Development.
  The existing 4-level parking structure located at 521 North Orange Street will be
  maintained as such. Above this structure, five levels of multi-family dwelling units
  are proposed . Each level will contain will contain nine residential units, which range
  from 835 square feet to 1,496 square feet in area.

  Planning Commissioners expressed that they would like to continue this project and the
  applicant to provide more information.
  MOTION
  Moved by Planning Commissioner Lee, seconded by Planning Commissioner
  Shahbazian, that upon review and consideration of Vesting Tentative Tract Map No.
  82713 located at 520 North Central Avenue & 521 North Orange Street, is continued to
  the next regularly scheduled hearing of the Planning Commission on February 19,
  2020, without further public notice. Applicant to provide more information.

  VOTE
  Ayes:  Astorian, Lee, Minassian, Shahbazian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Chraghchian
  Abstain:  None
